findings: SyncModels uses optString/optLong/optInt/optBoolean defaults for missing or invalid data. Arrays skip nonobject elements. This can turn malformed/partial payload into valid-looking smaller list without explicit error/completeness state. Actual incoming payload reachability not yet reviewed.

DuplicateGroup trusts fileCount,size,totalBytes separately from files; no nonnegative/count/arithmetic/groupidentity consistency validation in model. Truncated desktop list can legitimately differ from count, so inequality alone is not defect. Schema/provenance rather than blanket equality required.
SearchResult/DriveInfo/IndexStatus contain metadata and status only, no source snapshot/fileidentity/per-file-readerror observation. Data structure is not proof of content identity.

PreferencesManager stores settings in DataStore preferences, not SharedPreferences as AndroidREADME says. Most setters assign unvalidated strings for enumlike themes/sorts/drive; downstream handling pending review.
DataStore getOrCreateDeviceId checks and creates within singleedit transaction; avoids separate read/write interleaving at this helper. Not tested concurrently.
Settings getters default only on absentkey; no errorrecovery catch in these Flows. IO/corruption error handling must occur callers or DataStore configuration; not inferred from defaults.

SecurityViewModel collects preference flows and initially locks when savedPIN arrives, relocks on resume call, clears entry on success/error. Actual activity lifecycle/biometric integration still pending; no security bypass conclusion from standalone methods.
Setters launch persistence coroutines and returnwithout acknowledgment/error state in this ViewModel; visible saveconfirmation/error handling downstream unreviewed. Source observation only.
No duplicate matching, hashing, vector similarity or file move/delete implementation in these threefiles. No code adoption or performance claim.
